_comment: Copy to ~/.kannaktopus/config/arms/ferryman.json. The key comes from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, never from this file. Each source is a READ-ONLY collector: argv (no shell), run with a timeout, stdout becomes one input. Collectors must never send, post or mark anything; keep credentials in their own env files. The runner does NOT enforce read-only: it runs whatever argv is here, so `ferryman config` prints every argv for review.
